description: This file defines a controller class 'Featured' for the OpenCart admin extension module 'featured', handling CRUD operations and rendering views related to this module.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'featured' module within OpenCart's admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the main view for the 'featured' module configuration, assembling breadcrumbs, loading model data, and passing data to the view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to save or update module settings, with permission and validation checks, returning JSON response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new 'featured' module instance with default data, after permission check, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module instance given its 'module_id', with permission check, returning JSON response.
